title: Redux DevTools
description: Learn how to debug Redux applications with DevTools.

data.text: **Redux DevTools** is a browser extension that provides powerful debugging capabilities for Redux applications, including time-travel debugging.

items: **State diff**: See what changed after each action

data.title: DevTools Setup
Time Travel
data.text: Click any action in the DevTools to 'time travel' to that point in state history. This is invaluable for debugging.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Redux Toolkit enables it by default
data.takeaway: Redux DevTools makes debugging much easier.
